reviews.title: Powerful and fast, but some trade-offs
reviews.body: I’ve been using the HP OmniBook Ultra mainly for office work and coursework, and in terms of performance it’s been great. reviews.excerpt: On the downside, the display feels like a downgrade coming from an ASUS OLED laptop—it’s okay, but doesn’t have the same deep blacks or vibrant colors.
